The issuer displays extremely high leverage with total assets of 164,787M supported by only 5,987M in shareholders' equity (an assets-to-equity multiplier of over 27x), alongside weak profitability characterized by a very low 2% operating margin and a net loss of 4M on 22,217M in revenue. While the company maintains a massive asset base and positive retained earnings of 17,162M, the tight current ratio of 1.18 and thin equity cushion present substantial credit risk. Therefore, the company exhibits a highly leveraged, speculative-grade profile.

DECISION: B-
